Biskupice Old Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Biskupice, Poland

Demolished. This is the older of two Jewish cemeteries in Biskupice that have shared a single fence and been treated as one combined site since the 1930s. The old cemetery sits atop an artificial hill built specifically for its purposes, separated from the newer, flat cemetery next to it by a ditch that was once part of a water-fed moat drawing from the nearby Giełczew river — an unusually elaborate boundary feature for a cemetery in this collection. No further historical narrative survives in the source record.
